youtube_description:
Jesus... I ran the tap so my family wouldn't hear me cry. Then I came out and ate dinner. 🚿

She cries in the bathroom with the tap running so the family never hears.

She: Jesus... I ran the tap so my family wouldn't hear me cry. Then I came out and ate dinner. 🚿

Jesus: You turned the tap up twice. You thought no one was listening.

She: I just don't want to be a burden at home.

Jesus: Nothing you hide in there is hidden from Me.

She: Then what are the tears even for?

Jesus: Not for a drain. I keep count of every one.

Jesus: Not one tear went unseen. Not even the quiet ones.

“You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?”
Psalm 56:8 (BSB)
